fusions.name: Leaf Cuts
fusions.desc: Flicks 3 stiffened leaves at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 20% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Struck Through
fusions.desc: A single ruled cut on a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 16 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more for each one.

fusions.name: Turn to the Page
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Annotated Forms
fusions.desc: Every ability you use builds a stack on you, up to 4. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (24% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
